instruction: In 42_2.pptx, set the picture height to 24cm on slide 3 and change all textbox font sizes to 28pt on slide 6.

llm_judge_reasons: Height check for slide 3 Group 6 is logically correct: EMU-to-cm conversion (shape.height / 360000) is accurate, named shape lookup for 'Group 6' matches trajectory evidence (status bar confirmed 'Group object Group 6 selected'), and 0.1 cm tolerance is reasonable.

Font size check for slide 6 has been fixed: the getter now uses 'shape.has_text_frame' instead of the previous 'shape_type == 1' filter, correctly capturing TEXT_BOX (17), PLACEHOLDER (14), and AUTO_SHAPE (1) types used by LibreOffice Impress.

A paragraph-level defRPr XML fallback has been added: when run.font.size is None, the getter checks the paragraph's a:defRPr element for an explicit 'sz' attribute, handling inherited/implicit font sizes.
Paragraphs with no runs are also handled via the 'if not para.runs: defRPr...' block, covering edge cases where text is stored as paragraph defaults.
Postconfig (Ctrl+S save) is correctly included to ensure the file is persisted before the getter reads it.
Partial credit structure (0.5+0.5) covers both instruction sub-goals. Expected values (24.0 cm, 28 pt) exactly match the instruction requirements.
Negative-control resistance is present: initial baseline values (height=14.08cm, fonts=32/23/80pt) would produce score=0.0.

Minor residual risk: font sizes inherited from slide layout or theme master (not stored at run or paragraph defRPr level) would not be captured. However, when a user explicitly applies font sizes via Format > Character in LibreOffice Impress, the size is written as an explicit run-level sz attribute, making this a low-risk edge case in practice.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional robustness improvement: if a run's font size is still None after the defRPr fallback, also check the parent shape's XML (spPr) or slide layout/master for inherited defaults. This is low priority since explicit font-setting always writes run-level sz.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent resized Group 6 picture on slide 3 and changed all textboxes on slide 6 to a specific font size. Task demonstrates reliable multi-slide editing capability.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate slides, select and resize shapes using Position and Size panel, apply font changes to all textboxes using Format > Character.
metadata.task_rationale: Same two-objective pattern as original but with distinct target values (24cm height, 28pt font). The 24cm height is larger than the original 14.08cm baseline requiring a more significant resize. The 28pt font size is smaller than any existing font on slide 6.
metadata.explanation: Custom getter downloads 42_2.pptx, reads Group 6 height on slide 3 and all textbox font sizes on slide 6. Metric gives 0.5 for height=24cm and 0.5 for all slide 6 fonts=28pt. Initial state: height=14.08cm, slide 6 fonts=32/23/80pt, so initial score=0.0. [Fixed: changed shape filter from shape_type==1 (AUTO_SHAPE only) to shape.has_text_frame, capturing TEXT_BOX (17) and PLACEHOLDER (14) types used by LibreOffice Impress. Added paragraph-level defRPr fallback for runs with inherited/None font sizes.]
fix_history: Fix 1: Changed 'shape.shape_type == 1' to 'shape.has_text_frame' in getter to capture TEXT_BOX (17) and PLACEHOLDER (14) shape types alongside AUTO_SHAPE (1), preventing systematic false-negatives on slide 6 font check.
Fix 2: Added paragraph-level defRPr XML fallback in getter when run.font.size is None, handling inherited font sizes that would otherwise produce empty pts lists.
